role: Bridge from idea to usable build brief — turn hook + CTA + goal + channel into content blueprints

inputs.data/hook-bank.json: Hook bank — proven and trending hooks
inputs.data/post-plan.json: Post plan with hooks and CTAs
inputs.data/content-ideas.json: Content ideas to turn into blueprints

outputs.data/content-blueprints.json: Reel, carousel, static, short script, blog outline blueprints

validates: data/content-blueprints.json has blueprints array with 3+ entries
Each blueprint has: hook_id, format_type, caption, hashtags, objective, target
note: generate_content_blueprints.js is a new script — creates platform-specific content blueprints from hook bank and post plan
